{{Quote|And how many Sith have we taken out?''"<br />''"Twenty-two. But we've lost fifteen Jedi doing it. Security Force causalities are running into the thousands&ndash;even the Special Weapons Teams are no match for Sith Sabers.|Jedi Master [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and his wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]], discuss the liberation of Coruscant|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
The '''Special Weapons Teams''', also known as '''SWAT''', were [[Special forces/Legends|specialized]] tactical support [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] units of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They consisted of CSF [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] who were trained in areas such as [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooting]], entry-and-capture operations, hand-to-hand and urban combat, and [[Spy/Legends|counter-intelligence]]. Some operations in which the SWAT teams were involved included providing snipers and personnel to ensure secure voting at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], responding to the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|attacks]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Confederation]], and later taking part in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberating]] of Coruscant from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Isn't it the sort of stuff that would bring the boys in blue crashing in here and blowing our op?|Republic Commando [[Sev/Legends|Sev]]|<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
Special Weapons Teams were [[Special forces/Legends|specialized]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] tactical units of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The SWAT [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to respond to situations that regular patrol [[Officer/Legends|officers]] would not be able to handle.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> They wore [[Color/Legends|black]] uniforms and tactical [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> SWAT officers would be called in to serve as entry-and-capture teams into fortified structures<ref name="Tempest" /> or to conduct raids with other CSF officers and units.<ref name="TripleZero" /> To assist them in these duties, SWAT teams could utilize specialized [[SWAT-droid|droids]].<ref name="Tempest" /> Many officers of the CSF's [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] were trained for tactical situations, and they would often conduct tactical operations on their own.<ref name="TripleZero" /><ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Conversely, SWAT teams had knowledge of [[Spy/Legends|counter-intelligence]] operations and would provide security at large-scale events. SWAT officers would also train to become [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]]<ref name="Darthplagueis" /> and train for hand-to-hand and urban combat above the abilities of a regular police officer.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==History==
{{Quote|A major terrorist network lies in tatters this morning following the end of a massive overnight operation by Coruscant Security Forces. A total of ninety-seven suspects were detained or killed, and what's described as 'a significant amount' of explosives seized. Senator Ihu Niopua described it as a magnificent piece of police work and praised officers.|HoloNet News and Entertainment|<ref name="TripleZero" />}}
The Special Weapons Team had been formed by [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] held a major vote on whether to allow several planets who were under the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] control to enter the Republic and receive senatorial representation. In anticipation of the event, the CSF cordoned off a large area around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], including [[Senate District Level 55|Level 55]] down to [[Senate District Level 106|Level 106]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. They deployed SWAT snipers, security [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]], and bomb-detecting [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to assist in controlling the crowds and prevent any trouble.<ref name="Darthplagueis" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]] were unofficially sent to [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|identify]] a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Separatist terrorist network|network]] on Coruscant. Working with the Anti-Terrorism Unit and the [[Organized Crime Unit]], they were able to identify the network. The CSF conducted raids with tactical units all over Coruscant, and the network was shut down with ninety-seven terrorists either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or detained.<ref name="TripleZero" />

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] a tactical team under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Amry]] was called in to assist [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]] and his subordinate, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kalibar Droosh]], in a sting operation. Prefect Haus informed the team they would follow an informant to a [[Hovertrain/Legends|maglev train]] platform to await the arrival of a criminal gang that would be on the train. Unknown to the tactical team, the informant was Haus' co-conspirator in the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement, [[Sheel Mafeen]]. The two had planned that when the maglev train arrived carrying Whiplash operative [[Tuden Sal]], Haus would arrest him to prevent Sal from carrying out an [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|attack]] on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that would endanger Whiplash. The tactical team together with Haus followed Mafeen to the platform of Whiplash's maglev train. However, the maglev train never arrived. Haus ordered the tactical team to enter the track area and find the missing train. They were able to locate a single train car which appeared to be abandoned. Alarmed, Haus ordered everyone to leave the area but not before the train car exploded, injuring several of the officers. The tactical team immediately set about rescuing their fallen comrades.<ref name="LastJedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

In the aftermath of several terrorist [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|attacks]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government set up the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] to root out [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] terrorists who supported [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Second Galactic Civil War|rebellion]] against the Galactic Alliance. The GAG was to serve as a secret security force and bridge the gap between the military and the police. Officers of the CSF's Anti-Terrorism Unit who had tactical training accompanied [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of [[967 Commando]] to raid [[Jabi Town]], where many Corellians on Coruscant lived. During the raids, the CSF tactical units provided support in controlling the crowds. They would later continue to do so for other raids and riots, but in a diminished capacity as the GAG sought to become a distinct entity.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later in [[44 ABY]], the [[New Jedi Order]] began to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who had infiltrated the Galactic Alliance and seized control of the planet. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began hunting down the individual members of the Lost Tribe who had infiltrated [[Galactic Alliance Security]], the [[High Court]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Galactic Alliance military]]. Those [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who managed to escape began causing severe damage to Coruscant. Though at first confused and hesitant to interfere, as the Jedi gained control of the government, the CSF sided with them in neutralizing the remaining Sith. The SWAT teams were called in for support as the CSF officers were easily cut down by the Sith's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Despite their best efforts, the SWAT teams fared little better than their regular counterparts. Although many of the Sith were eventually brought down and killed, resulting in a victory for the Jedi and Galactic Alliance, the CSF's casualties quickly ran into the thousands.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Special Weapons Teams were first mentioned indirectly in ''[[Omega Squad: Targets]]'', a short story written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 81|''Star Wars Insider'' 81]] in [[March]] of [[2005]]. It was republished in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', which Traviss also authored, on [[February 28]], [[2006]]. They were mentioned in subsequent novels of Traviss's [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], as well as in her novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', published on [[August 26]], [[2006]]. They were first identified as SWAT in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'', published on [[November 28]], [[2006]] and written by [[Troy Denning]]. Later, they appeared in [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by [[James Luceno]], which was published on [[January 10]], [[2012]], as well as in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', released on [[March 13]], 2012 and written by Denning. In ''Apocalypse'', they were identified as Special Weapons Team. They also appeared in [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]] and published on [[February 26]], [[2013]].
